parameters.content:
## Human Review Flow

Route tickets requiring manual intervention to a review queue, record the review audit data, and save the output for follow-up.

## Approved Flow

Approved tickets, prepare the ITSM update, generate an audit record, and save the approved output. Configure the ITSM integration before enabling this path.

## Manual Input + Normalization

Provide the support ticket text and extraction rules. Normalize the input while preserving the original ticket content for traceability.

## Clocked Extract and Merge

Extract structured ticket details using Clocked Extract (https://clocked.rezolve.ai/extract) and merge the API response with the original input and correlation ID.

## Clocked Decide and Merge

Use Clocked Decide (https://clocked.rezolve.ai/decide) to evaluate the ticket based on the extracted data and context, then merge the decision with the ticket information.

## Parse & Validate

Parse the extraction results, validate required fields and data types, and flag missing or invalid information for review.

## Evaluate

Apply business rules and confidence thresholds to determine whether the ticket qualifies for automated processing or requires human review.

## Support Ticket Data Extraction – Analysis & Routing Automation with Clocked (https://clocked.rezolve.ai/)

### How it works

Extracts and validates support ticket data using Clocked Extract, then applies Clocked Decide to route tickets for automated updates or human review, recording audit outputs for both paths.

Configure API credentials, extraction rules, decision criteria, confidence thresholds, and output paths. Test with valid, incomplete, and ambiguous tickets.
